content.value_statement: React Native apps can suffer from slow lists, janky animations, and platform mistakes. This skill gives Codex, Claude, and Claude Code concise rules for performant Expo and React Native work.
actual_capabilities: Explains React Native rendering rules that prevent Text and falsy value crashes.
Recommends virtualized list patterns for FlatList, LegendList, and FlashList.
Guides animation choices toward transform, opacity, Reanimated, and Gesture Handler patterns.
Advises on native navigation, safe areas, images, menus, modals, and styling.
Describes state patterns that reduce stale data and unnecessary re-renders.
Covers monorepo dependency placement and shared package version guidance.
limitations: It is guidance-only and does not run project analysis by itself.
It does not replace profiling on real iOS and Android devices.
Some recommendations depend on installed libraries and project architecture.
It may need updates as React Native, Expo, and React Compiler change.

use_cases.title: Review Performance Risks
use_cases.description: A mobile developer asks Claude or Codex to inspect a screen for slow lists, expensive items, and unsafe rendering.

use_cases.title: Plan Expo Architecture
use_cases.description: A tech lead uses the skill to choose navigation, image, font, and dependency patterns before implementation.

use_cases.title: Refactor UI Components
use_cases.description: A design system maintainer applies rules for Pressable, safe areas, modals, menus, and compound components.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React Native component against the skill rules. Focus on rendering safety, state, images, and obvious performance issues.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a List Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this list screen for virtualization, item weight, object references, callbacks, image sizing, and item type handling.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Animations and Gestures
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor these animation and press interactions using Reanimated guidance. Prefer transform, opacity, derived values, and GestureDetector patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Performance Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration plan for this Expo app using the skill. Prioritize rendering, lists, navigation, state architecture, and native dependency placement.

output_examples.input: A feed screen renders every item inside a scrolling container.
output: Replace full upfront rendering with a virtualized list.
Keep item props primitive when possible.
Move expensive fetching and derived work to the parent.

output_examples.input: A button changes width during press feedback.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend transform or opacity animation, with press state handled through GestureDetector for smoother UI-thread feedback.

output_examples.input: A monorepo adds a native dependency to a shared package.
output_examples.output: The skill would advise installing the native dependency in the app package and keeping versions aligned across the workspace.

best_practices: Use the skill before writing list screens, animation code, or navigation structure.
Pair the rules with profiling when a change affects scroll or gesture performance.
Ask for rule citations when applying guidance to a large refactor.
anti_patterns: Treating the rules as a substitute for testing on real devices.
Applying every recommendation without checking the project architecture.
Using full upfront rendering for repeatable list content.

faq.question: Does this skill modify my app automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance that an AI assistant can apply when you ask for implementation or review.

faq.question: Which projects fit this skill?
faq.answer: It fits React Native and Expo apps, especially screens with lists, animations, navigation, images, and native dependencies.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it for reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill gives structured rules that Claude Code, Codex, and Claude can use during code review.

faq.question: Does it require React Compiler?
faq.answer: No. It includes React Compiler guidance, but most rules also apply without it.

faq.question: Does it cover security hardening?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on React Native performance, rendering, and platform patterns, not security architecture.

faq.question: How current are the recommendations?
faq.answer: The skill metadata lists version 1.0.0 from January 2026. Check library docs for breaking changes.
